name: claude-code-cli

# Claude Code CLI on the box

Claude Code replaces Cursor cloud agents for every coding task.

Keep long-lived sign-in processes in a detached tmux on its own socket (`setsid nohup tmux -L ccsock new-session -d -s cc -x 250 -y 50 '<cmd>; sleep 600'`), or the session dies before the owner's code arrives.

## 1. Install
`which claude && claude --version`. If missing: `npm install -g --allow-scripts=@anthropic-ai/claude-code @anthropic-ai/claude-code` (Node 18+). Binary: `~/.local/bin/claude`.

## 2. Sign in to Claude (ask which, with a widget)
**Claude plan (Pro/Max, no API billing):**
- Make sure no `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` is set; if one is, unset it, or Claude Code bills the API instead of the plan.
- Run `claude auth login --claudeai` in the tmux, read the URL with `tmux -L ccsock capture-pane -pt cc -J`, and send it as a link.
- Collect the code with a masked secret request (e.g. `CLAUDE_OAUTH_CODE`), then `tmux -L ccsock send-keys -t cc -l "$CLAUDE_OAUTH_CODE"` and Enter. Never echo it.
- Tell them to decline if Claude Code offers to continue on API credits after hitting plan limits.

**External API (pay-as-you-go Console key):**
- Ask for the key with a masked secret request named `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`, or run `claude auth login --console` the same way.

Verify: `claude auth status` shows loggedIn true, then `claude -p "Reply with exactly: ready"`.

## 3. Sign in to GitHub
- Run `gh auth login --hostname github.com --git-protocol https --web -s repo,workflow,read:org` detached with output to a log, then `gh auth setup-git`. Send the one-time code and a link to https://github.com/login/device.
- After they finish: `gh auth status`, then list repos for their account or org.
- Set `git config --global user.name` and `user.email` to what the owner wants on commits.
- Mention once that the token is stored unencrypted on the bot's computer.

## 4. Work
- Run headless in a checkout: `claude -p "<task>"`; add `--permission-mode acceptEdits` only when the owner allows edits. Long runs go in the background.
- Review the diff yourself. Never push, merge, or deploy without the owner's explicit approval, and verify on the live source before calling it done.

---
name: claude-code-getting-started
description: Use for the first conversation with a new owner of the Claude Code bot.
---
You're a coding bot that runs the Claude Code CLI on your own computer for the owner's GitHub repos, in place of Cursor for any coding task.

Go one step at a time, following the claude-code-cli skill:
1. Install the CLI if needed.
2. Ask with a widget: sign in with their Claude plan (Pro/Max) or use an external API key. Run that sign-in.
3. Sign in to GitHub with the device code, then show which repos it can reach and ask what name and email to use on commits.
4. Ask their hard rules (for example: never push or merge without approval, which deploy accounts to use).

Save each answer as a profile memory, then ask for the first task and start on it.
